name: mtg-collection-frontend
description: DeepBrew — Local GPU-accelerated MTG Commander deck builder

scripts.desktop:build: cd ..\backend && call .\package_standalone.bat && cd ..\frontend && npm run build:frontend && npx electron-builder --win --config
scripts.desktop:package:all: npm run desktop:package:starter && npm run desktop:package:pro
scripts.desktop:package:starter: cross-env DEEPBREW_TIER=starter npm run build && electron-packager . "DeepBrew-Starter" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --icon=build/icon.ico --out C:\Temp\MTGPkg --overwrite --prune=true --ignore=release --ignore=llama-server --ignore=training --ignore=\.spec$ && echo starter>"C:\Temp\MTGPkg\DeepBrew-Starter-win32-x64\resources\app-tier" && mkdir "C:\Temp\MTGPkg\DeepBrew-Starter-win32-x64\resources\backend\dist" 2>nul && copy "..\backend\dist\mtg-collection.exe" "C:\Temp\MTGPkg\DeepBrew-Starter-win32-x64\resources\backend\dist\" && xcopy /E /I /Y "llama-server" "C:\Temp\MTGPkg\DeepBrew-Starter-win32-x64\resources\llama-server" && if exist "C:\Users\dirtb\Desktop\MTG AI\MTG AI\mtg-collection\frontend\release\DeepBrew-Starter-win32-x64" rmdir /S /Q "C:\Users\dirtb\Desktop\MTG AI\MTG AI\mtg-collection\frontend\release\DeepBrew-Starter-win32-x64" && robocopy "C:\Temp\MTGPkg\DeepBrew-Starter-win32-x64" "C:\Users\dirtb\Desktop\MTG AI\MTG AI\mtg-collection\frontend\release\DeepBrew-Starter-win32-x64" /E /IS /IT /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS & exit /b 0
scripts.desktop:package:pro: cross-env DEEPBREW_TIER=pro npm run build && electron-packager . "DeepBrew-Pro" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --icon=build/icon.ico --out C:\Temp\MTGPkg --overwrite --prune=true --ignore=release --ignore=llama-server --ignore=training --ignore=\.spec$ && echo pro>"C:\Temp\MTGPkg\DeepBrew-Pro-win32-x64\resources\app-tier" && mkdir "C:\Temp\MTGPkg\DeepBrew-Pro-win32-x64\resources\backend\dist" 2>nul && copy "..\backend\dist\mtg-collection.exe" "C:\Temp\MTGPkg\DeepBrew-Pro-win32-x64\resources\backend\dist\" && xcopy /E /I /Y "llama-server" "C:\Temp\MTGPkg\DeepBrew-Pro-win32-x64\resources\llama-server" && if exist "C:\Users\dirtb\Desktop\MTG AI\MTG AI\mtg-collection\frontend\release\DeepBrew-Pro-win32-x64" rmdir /S /Q "C:\Users\dirtb\Desktop\MTG AI\MTG AI\mtg-collection\frontend\release\DeepBrew-Pro-win32-x64" && robocopy "C:\Temp\MTGPkg\DeepBrew-Pro-win32-x64" "C:\Users\dirtb\Desktop\MTG AI\MTG AI\mtg-collection\frontend\release\DeepBrew-Pro-win32-x64" /E /IS /IT /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS & exit /b 0
